I am from Iringa, where the rains are good and we grow much maize. My land is not small, so I work hard with my family. I will use a little fertilizer like my neighbors — one bag of CAN if I can manage, and the manure from my animals to help the soil. I have no school learning, but I know maize well, and I will plant improved seed because here in the Southern Highlands the agro-dealers bring it to our village. I cannot irrigate — we wait for the masika rains. For weeding and planting I will hire a few young men because my plots together are too big for my family alone.
